# shotproof

> Screenshot to code plugin for Claude Code and Codex. Turns a screenshot into matching HTML + CSS (or React + Tailwind) with no API key, using the agent's own model, then renders it in Chromium, scores it against the screenshot with SSIM and fixes it until it passes. MIT licensed.

Install in Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add deserteaglemj/shotproof
/plugin install shotproof@shotproof
```

Install in Codex:

```
codex plugin marketplace add deserteaglemj/shotproof
codex plugin add shotproof@shotproof
```

One-time helper setup: `python3 -m pip install playwright pillow numpy && python3 -m playwright install chromium`

Use: `/shotproof ./screenshot.png`, `/shotproof ./app.png react`, or ask "turn this screenshot into code".

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/deserteaglemj/shotproof/blob/main/README.md): what it does, install, modes, comparison with abi/screenshot-to-code, limitations, FAQ
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/deserteaglemj/shotproof/blob/main/plugins/shotproof/skills/shotproof/SKILL.md): the full workflow the agent follows (intake, read, build, verify and fix loop, report)
- [Private client proof rules](https://github.com/deserteaglemj/shotproof/blob/main/plugins/shotproof/skills/shotproof/references/private-proof.md)
- [Eval results](https://github.com/deserteaglemj/shotproof/blob/main/evals/RESULTS.md): 8 cases, all pass, independently re-scored
